blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity visual synthesis, yet realistic motion remains challenging. Generated videos may exhibit temporal discontinuities, inconsistent action progression, and structural distortions during complex movements. Even when individual frames appear realistic, the underlying motion may evolve in inconsistent or implausible ways. Standard generative objectives provide limited motion-specific supervision, leaving motion evolution insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we propose MotionSpec, a motion supervision framework centered on Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC). STC constructs dense anchor-relative motion trajectories and transforms them into motion spectral volumes via a temporal Fourier transform. By aligning the spectral amplitude and phase of predicted and target trajectories, STC constrains both motion strength across temporal frequencies and the temporal organization of motion. To complement this trajectory-level supervision, we introduce Local Flow Consistency (LFC), which aligns consecutive-frame optical flow between predicted and target videos to stabilize local motion transitions. Experiments demonstrate that MotionSpec consistently improves motion consistency, temporal coherence, and plausibility while preserving visual fidelity. We will make our code publicly available.
blocks.zh: 最近在文本到视频生成方面的进展使得高真实度的视觉合成成为可能,然而现实运动仍然具有挑战性. 生成的视频可能显示时间不连续,动作进展不一致,在复杂的运动中结构扭曲. 即使单个帧看起来是现实的,基础运动也可能以不一致或不合理的方式演变. 标准基因目标提供有限的运动特定监督,使运动进化受限不足. 在本文中,我们提出MotionSpec,一个以光谱轨迹一致性(STC)为中心的运动监督框架. STC构建密集的锚-相对运动轨迹,并通过时间Fourier变换将其转化为运动光谱卷. 通过调整预测和目标轨迹的光谱振幅和相位,STC既限制了跨时间频率的运动强度,也限制了运动的时间组织. 为了补充这种轨迹层面的监管,我们引入了本地流一致性(LFC),它将预测视频和目标视频之间的连续帧光学流调和,以稳定本地运动过渡. 实验证明,MotionSpec在保持视觉忠诚的同时,不断提高运动一致性,时间一致性和可信度. 我们将公布我们的代码。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in text-to-video (T2V) generation have enabled high-fidelity and text-aligned video synthesis with scalable diffusion and flow-matching architectures [ 15 , 21 , 23 , 13 , 4 ] . However, strong visual quality does not necessarily imply realistic motion. Generated videos may still exhibit temporal discontinuities, inconsistent action progression, and structural distortions during complex movements [ 1 ] . These failures concern not only motion magnitude, but also how motion evolves over time.
A key limitation is the lack of explicit motion supervision in conventional objectives. Standard denoising and flow-matching losses learn appearance and temporal structure jointly through noise or velocity prediction, without directly constraining motion correspondences. Recent methods improve motion through joint appearance-motion learning [ 1 , 3 ] , decomposed conditioning [ 14 ] , optical-flow supervision [ 17 ] , motion-aware loss reweighting [ 16 , 18 , 22 ] , or flow-guided prompt optimization [ 9 ] . Spectral regularization has also been explored to improve motion in video generation [ 20 , 19 , 12 , 5 , 11 ] .
However, these approaches do not explicitly align the
temporal spectra of dense motion trajectories.
blocks.zh:
最近在文本到视频(T2V)生成方面的进步,使得能够以可伸缩的传播和流配式架构[15, 21, 23, 13, 4] 的高真度和文本同步视频合成. 然而,强烈的视觉质量并不一定意味着现实运动. 生成的视频仍可能显示时间不连续,动作进展不一致,以及复杂运动中的结构扭曲[1]. 这些失败不仅涉及运动量,也涉及运动如何随时间演变.
一个关键限制是,在常规目标中缺乏明确的动议监督。 标准调试和流量比对损失通过噪音或速度预测共同学习外观和时间结构,而不直接限制运动对应. 近代方法通过联合外观-运动学习[1,3],分解调节[14],光学-流导[17],运动-意识损失重载[16,18,22],或流导快速优化[. 9] (中文(简体) ). 还探索了光谱规范化,以改善视频生成中的运动[20,19,12,5,11].
然而,这些办法并未明确调整:
密集运动轨迹的时间谱.

blocks.en:
To characterize motion over multiple frames, we analyze the temporal spectra of dense motion trajectories. As shown in Fig. 1 , generated videos in our evaluation exhibit lower mean spectral amplitudes at nonzero temporal frequencies than real videos, with the largest absolute gaps at low temporal frequencies. The per-video amplitude statistics are also more concentrated near zero, whereas real videos exhibit a broader distribution.
Together, these observations indicate a tendency toward weaker trajectory variation in generated videos.
This motivates explicit supervision of motion trajectories across multiple frames through their temporal-frequency representations.
blocks.zh:
为了描述运动在多个框架上的特性,我们分析密集运动轨迹的时间光谱. 如图1所示,我们评价生成的视频显示,在非零时间频率下,平均光谱振幅低于真实视频,在低时间频率下,绝对差距最大。 按视频显示的振幅统计数字也比较集中,接近零,而真实的视频则显示分布范围更广。
这些观察表明,生成的视频的轨迹变化较弱。
这促使人们通过其时间频率的表示,明确监督跨多帧的运动轨迹。

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose MotionSpec, a motion supervision framework centered on Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC). We construct dense anchor-relative displacement trajectories and transform them into motion spectral volumes (MSV) [ 6 ] . STC explicitly aligns the trajectory spectra of generated videos with those of real videos through amplitude and phase supervision, constraining both the distribution of motion energy across temporal frequencies and the temporal organization of motion. To complement this trajectory-level spectral supervision, we further introduce Local Flow Consistency (LFC), which aligns adjacent-frame optical flow between predicted and target videos to stabilize local motion transitions. Together, these objectives provide explicit supervision for motion evolution during video generation.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提议以光谱轨迹一致性(STC)为中心的运动监督框架MotionSpec。 我们构建密集的锚-相对转移轨迹,并将其转化为运动光谱体积[6]。 STC通过振幅和相位监督,明确将生成的视频的轨迹光谱与真实视频的轨迹光谱对齐,制约了运动能量跨时间频率的分布和运动的时间组织. 为了补充这种轨迹级光谱监督,我们进一步引入了本地流一致性(LFC),它将预测和目标视频之间的相邻帧光学流对齐,以稳定本地运动过渡. 这些目标共同为视频生成过程中的运动进化提供了明确的监督.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the pipeline. At each training step, the video generative model takes the prompt c c , timestep t t , noise level σ \sigma , and real data as inputs. After obtaining the clean latent and decoding it into a video, both the generated and ground-truth videos are fed into an optical flow estimator to compute the Local Flow Consistency loss and the Spectral Trajectory Consistency loss. These objectives are jointly optimized with the flow matching loss.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC), a motion supervision objective that aligns the temporal spectra of dense motion trajectories between generated and real videos. • We develop MotionSpec, which incorporates STC into video generation and complements it with LFC to stabilize adjacent-frame motion transitions. • Experiments show consistent improvements in motion quality, temporal coherence, and structural stability while preserving visual appearance.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了光谱轨迹一致性(STC),这是一个运动监督目标,它使生成的和真实的视频之间密集运动轨迹的时间光谱对齐. ^ 我们开发MotionSpec,将STC集成到视频生成中,并与LFC互补,稳定相邻的帧运动过渡. • 实验显示,在保持视觉外观的同时,运动质量、时间一致性和结构稳定性持续改善。

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 illustrates the overall MotionSpec framework.
The predicted and ground-truth videos are passed through a frozen optical-flow estimator to extract motion representations. Our main objective, Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC), constructs anchor-relative motion trajectories and supervises their temporal spectra to constrain longer-range motion evolution. We additionally employ Local Flow Consistency (LFC) to align adjacent-frame optical flow and stabilize local motion transitions. Both objectives are jointly optimized with the flow-matching loss.

2.3 Spectral Trajectory Consistency
blocks.zh: 2.3 光谱轨迹一致性

blocks.en:
Adjacent-frame flow does not explicitly constrain motion evolution over a longer temporal horizon. A generated video may therefore contain plausible local transitions while exhibiting unrealistic motion decay, trajectory drift, or inconsistent long-term dynamics.
To capture such patterns, we construct anchor-relative motion
trajectories.
Given a temporal anchor a a , the target displacement from
the anchor frame to a future frame is: G a , τ = 𝒪 ⁡ ( x a , x a + τ ) , G_{a,\tau}=\mathcal{O}(x_{a},x_{a+\tau}), (4) where τ = 1 , … , L \tau=1,\ldots,L and L L is the trajectory horizon.
We use a set of sliding temporal anchors that start from the first frame
and advance with stride s s . Only anchors satisfying a + L ≤ T a+L\leq T are
retained. This allows the spectral objective to characterize multiple
temporal segments within the same video.

Dataset. We filtered 10K training videos from OpenVid-1M [ 10 ] based on motion magnitude and prompt content, covering human,
object, and complex motion.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们过滤了来自OpenVid-1M[10]的10K训练视频,基于运动量和即时内容,覆盖人类,

blocks.en: Backbone. We choose Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 15 ] as our backbone for its representative architecture, and manageable model size, which facilitates single-GPU fine-tuning and multiple ablation studies.

blocks.en: 3.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 量化结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative comparison. FM-only denotes fine-tuning with the flow-matching objective alone. + + LFC and + + STC add the respective objective to FM-only, while Ours incorporates both.
blocks.zh: 表1:定量比较。 只调频表示仅与流量比对目标进行微调. + + LFC和+ + STC 将相应目标加到只调频,而Ours则兼收并蓄.

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the quantitative results. To control for the effect of curated dataset, we include an FM-only baseline that uses the same training configuration but optimizes only the flow-matching objective. FM-only increases the average VMBench score from 61.57 to 62.18, indicating that fine-tuning alone o n the dataset contributes to the improvement. Both LFC and STC provide further gains, and their combination achieves the best overall performance.
blocks.zh: 表1列出定量结果。 为了控制编译数据集的效果,我们包括了一个只使用调频的基线,使用相同的训练配置,但只优化了流量匹配目标. 只调频将平均VMBench的得分从61.57提高到62.18,表明光是微调on数据集就有助于改进. LFC和STC都提供了进一步的收益,两者的结合实现了最佳的总体业绩.

blocks.en:
The two objectives exhibit complementary performance profiles. LFC achieves a higher object integrity score than STC, whereas STC achieves higher temporal coherence and VideoJAM-Bench motion scores. Combining both objectives further improves OIS to 56.53 and TCS to 98.82, outperforming either component alone on these dimensions.
Our full model also improves the appearance score from 81.95 to 82.20 compared with FM-only. Its PAS increases from 22.91 to 23.74, indicating that the gains in motion quality are accompanied by an increase in perceptible motion amplitude. While LFC alone achieves the highest PAS, the full model obtains the highest average VMBench score, with improvements over FM-only across all five dimensions.
blocks.zh:
这两项目标显示出互补的业绩概况。 LFC的物体完整性得分比STC更高,而STC则实现时间一致性更高,VideoJAM-Bench运动得分也更高. 将这两个目标结合起来,使伊办的成绩进一步提高到56.53,技术合作支助的成绩提高到98.82,在这些方面,两个部分都比两个部分都好。
我们的完整型号也使外观分数从81.95分提高到82.20分,而只使用调频. 其PAS从22.91增加到23.74,表明运动质量的提高伴随着可见运动振幅的增加. 虽然单LFC实现最高PAS,但全模型获得最高的平均VMBench分数,在所有五个维度上均比FM改进.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative Results. On the left are the results of Wan2.1, and on the right are the results of ours. It can be observed that in our results, the motion patterns are more realistic and the motion performance is significantly better.
blocks.zh: 图3:定性结果。 左边是Wan2.1的结果,右边是我们的结果。 可以看到,在我们的结果中,运动模式更加现实,运动性能明显更好.

blocks.en: 3.3 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 3.3 定性结果

blocks.en:
Figure 3 presents qualitative comparisons between Wan2.1 and our method. In the first row, the boy generated by Wan2.1 appears to cycle backward toward the camera, producing an unnatural motion pattern. In contrast, our method generates a boy facing the camera and riding naturally toward it, showing better consistency between body orientation and the direction of motion.
In the second and third rows, Wan2.1 exhibits limb distortions and blurred body regions during running, whereas our method produces more coherent body structures and clearer motion across frames. These examples highlight the difficulty of preserving structural consistency under fast and complex human motion. In the fourth row, which depicts a girl hula-hooping, Wan2.1 shows inconsistent clothing appearance and deformations of the hoop during the motion. Our method maintains more stable clothing appearance and better preserves the hoop’s shape throughout the sequence.
blocks.zh:
图3显示Wan2.1和我们的方法之间的定性比较。 在第一排,Wan2.1产生的男孩似乎向着镜头向后循环,产生了一种非自然的运动模式. 相比之下,我们的方法产生一个男孩面对摄像机并自然地向着它,显示出身体方向和运动方向之间更好的一致性.
在第二行和第三行中,Wan2.1在运行过程中显示出肢体扭曲和身体区域模糊,而我们的方法则产生更连贯的体质结构,更清晰的跨帧运动。 这些例子凸显了在快速复杂的人类运动下保持结构一致性的困难. 在描绘一个女孩呼拉机的第四行中,Wan2.1在运动中表现出了不连贯的衣着外观和霍普的变形. 我们的方法保持了更稳定的衣着外观,并在整个序列中更好地保持了霍普的形状.

blocks.en:
These observations are consistent with our motion objectives.
Motion-masked short-term flow supervision constrains local motion direction and magnitude in moving regions, while spectral trajectory consistency aligns the amplitude and phase spectra of anchor-relative motion trajectories to constrain longer-term motion evolution and temporal organization. Together, these objectives encourage coherent local transitions and more consistent motion dynamics, which may contribute to the improved structural stability and visual consistency observed in these examples.
blocks.zh:
这些意见符合我们的动议目标。
运动量化的短期流动监督会限制移动区域的局部运动方向和规模,而光谱轨迹一致性则会协调锚-相对运动轨迹的振幅和相位光谱,以制约较长期的运动进化和时间组织. 这些目标加在一起,鼓励地方的一致过渡和更加一致的运动动态,这可能有助于这些例子中观察到的结构稳定性和视觉一致性的改善。

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 3.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Table 1 has already demonstrated the individual and complementary effects of LFC and STC. We further analyze the internal components of STC, namely the spectral amplitude loss and the phase consistency loss. To isolate their contributions, all variants in this study are trained with LFC enabled, and differ only in the spectral supervision applied on top of it.
As shown in Table 2 , introducing either amplitude or phase supervision improves the motion-related metrics over the LFC-only baseline. The amplitude term mainly improves motion smoothness and structural stability by aligning the distribution of motion energy across temporal frequencies. In contrast, the phase term provides a larger gain in temporal coherence, indicating that phase information is important for preserving the temporal organization of long-range trajectories. Combining both terms yields the best overall performance.
blocks.zh:
表1已经证明了LFC和STC的个人和互补作用。 我们进一步分析STC的内部组件,即光谱振幅损失和相位一致性损失. 为了分离他们的贡献,本研究的所有变体都接受了LFC启用的训练,并且只在上面应用的光谱监督上有所不同.
如表2所示,采用振幅或相位监督可改进仅与LFC基准相比的与运动有关的衡量标准。 振幅词主要通过调和运动能量在时间频率上的分布,提高运动的光滑度和结构稳定性. 与此相反,相位词在时间一致性方面提供了更大的收益,表明相位信息对于维护长距离轨迹的时间组织非常重要. 将这两个术语结合起来,总体表现最好。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study on the components of spectral trajectory consistency.
blocks.zh: 表2:光谱轨迹一致性组成部分的偏差研究。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of time-domain and spectral trajectory supervision.
blocks.zh: 表3:时间域和光谱轨迹监督的差幅。

blocks.en: To determine whether the gain of STC merely come from long-range trajectory supervision, we compare it with a direct time-domain loss. As shown in Table 3 , time-domain supervision improves the motion and average scores over LFC alone, confirming the benefit of constraining long-range motion. Nevertheless, STC achieves higher scores, increasing the average score to 65.07. This suggests that STC benefits not only from a longer supervision horizon. By decomposing trajectories into temporal frequency components, STC separates motion energy from temporal organization through amplitude and phase supervision, providing a more structured constraint on motion evolution across temporal scales. In contrast, point-wise temporal matching penalizes trajectory discrepancies at individual temporal offsets without explicitly distinguishing slowly varying trends from faster temporal variations.
blocks.zh: 为了确定STC的收益是否仅仅来自于远程轨道监督,我们把它与直接的时间域损失相比较. 如表3所示,时间域监督仅能改善运动和平均分数高于LFC,证实了限制远程运动的好处. 尽管如此,STC还是取得了较高的分数,将平均分数提高到65.07. 这表明STC不仅受益于更长的监督范围. 通过将轨迹分解成时间频率元件,STC通过振幅和相位监督将运动能量与时间组织区分开来,为跨时间尺度的运动进化提供了更加结构化的制约. 相比之下,点对点时间匹配在个别时间抵消时惩罚轨迹差异,而没有明确区分缓慢变化的趋势和较快的时间变化。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We present MotionSpec, a motion supervision framework for motion-consistent video generation. STC constrains the frequency structure and temporal organization of motion trajectories, providing explicit supervision for motion evolution beyond adjacent frames. We complement STC with local flow consistency to stabilize local motion transitions in moving regions. Together, these objectives improve motion smoothness, structural stability, and temporal coherence without sacrificing visual fidelity. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across motion-oriented evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍 MotionSpec, 运动监督框架 运动一致的视频生成。 STC限制运动轨迹的频率结构和时间组织,为超越相邻框架的运动进化提供明确的监督. 我们在STC中补充了局部流的连贯性,稳定了迁移地区的局部运动过渡. 这些目标结合在一起,提高了运动的光滑度、结构稳定性和时间一致性,同时又不牺牲视觉上的忠诚。 实验表明,在以行动为导向的评价指标方面,不断改进。
